description: This file defines classes for integrating Google Generative AI models with LangChain, including a main class for chat models, configuration options, and support for structured output and multimodal features.

classes.name: LangchainChatGoogleGenerativeAI
classes.description: Main class for Google Generative AI chat model integration, supporting configuration, streaming, structured output, and multimodal features.

classes.name: ChatGoogleGenerativeAI
classes.description: Extended class supporting multimodal options and model reconfiguration.

methods.name: withStructuredOutput
methods.description: Configures the model to produce structured output based on a schema, supporting function calling and JSON schema methods.

methods.name: bindTools
methods.description: Binds external tools to the model for use during invocation.

methods.name: invocationParams
methods.description: Prepares invocation parameters for the model, including tools and response schema.

methods.name: _generate
methods.description: Generates a response from the model, handling streaming and non-streaming modes.

methods.name: _streamResponseChunks
methods.description: Streams response chunks from the model, yielding partial responses.

methods.name: completionWithRetry
methods.description: Calls the model's generateContent method with retry logic.
